title: An Empirical Study of Speculative Decoding on Software Engineering Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2604.26469v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become widely used for Software Engineering (SE) tasks, spanning from function-level code generation to complex repository-level workflows. However, the high latency of autoregressive inference remains a significant bottleneck, hindering their deployment in interactive environments. While Speculative Decoding (SD) offers a promising technique for lossless acceleration, prior research on long-context repository-level tasks and complex agentic interactions remains limited. To bridge this gap, we present the first systematic empirical study to evaluate the effectiveness of SD in SE tasks. We systematically benchmark a comprehensive spectrum of strategies, encompassing both model-based and model-free methods, across representative generation, editing, and repair scenarios. translated_title: 软件工程任务中推测解码的实证研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.26469v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）已广泛应用于软件工程（SE）任务，涵盖从函数级代码生成到复杂的仓库级工作流程。然而，自回归推理的高延迟仍然是一个显著瓶颈，阻碍了它们在交互环境中的部署。虽然推测解码（SD）提供了一种无损加速的有前景技术，但先前关于长上下文仓库级任务和复杂智能体交互的研究仍然有限。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了首个系统性实证研究，以评估SD在SE任务中的有效性。我们系统地基准测试了全面的策略谱系，涵盖基于模型和无模型方法，覆盖代表性的生成、编辑和修复场景。我们的实证结果表明，SD在加速推理方面展现出明显潜力，尤其是对于较小的模型。
tldr: 本文首次系统实证评估推测解码在软件工程任务中的加速效果，发现其尤其对小模型在生成、编辑和修复场景中表现出显著推理加速潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic empirical study evaluating speculative decoding's acceleration effectiveness in software engineering tasks, revealing significant inference speedup potential especially for smaller models in generation, editing, and repair scenarios.
